processing.source: imagegen raster art only; no procedurally drawn faces
processing.cell_partition: logical8x8 order; actual boundaries are midpoints of full-atlas black separator bands, minimum3px vertical or8px horizontal; exactly9 bands per axis including outer margins required
processing.visible_box: all nonzero palette pixels in the actual partition; visible pixels must not touch any partition edge; no component removed
processing.black_threshold: alpha below128 or maximum RGB channel at most32 -> transparent
processing.quantization: nearest squared RGB distance to black/white/orange/brown; ties choose lower index; no dithering
processing.fit: contain in30x38, aspect preserved; bottom aligned with1px black margin and horizontally centered
processing.resampling: Pillow NEAREST; no interpolation, sharpening, or geometry edits
processing.uniqueness: native RGBA SHA256 must be unique; same-gender unused-cell fallback only
